newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-AGASSI CRASHES OUT OF PARIS OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-AGASSI CRASHES OUT OF PARIS OPEN.

text.p: Andre Agassi, the winner in 1994, crashed out of the Paris Open when Swede Magnus Gustafsson upset him 6-4 3-6 6-3 in the second round on Tuesday.
The ninth-seeded American was the third seed to go out on the first day that the 16 seeds, given a bye in the opening round, joined the action.
Richard Krajicek of the Netherlands and Agassi's compatriot Jim Courier were the other seeded casualties.
The defeat virtually ends Agassi's chances of qualifying for the ATP Tour World Championship in Hanover next month.
But Agassi said: "I was just thinking about my game. I wasn't worring about the world championship."

Eight players qualify for the Hanover event and Agassi is currently in seventh place. But he confirmed he would not be playing another tournament this season, leaving the way open for others to overtake him.
